source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Ok. Let's go with this design. It still keeps alive the DJ Turntables vibe. Let's make the pour spot should be facing the baristas. I want the buttons to be functional and work. Let's try and make it as splash free as possible. Keep the words on the machine the same. Green accents. The only difference is I want it to say "Karla's Matcha Mixer". From the side view I like the thickness of the machine. I want deep matcha wells but I don't want the box to be too big.

value_updates.overall_size_constraint: Keep the enclosure reasonably compact rather than making the box too large.
value_updates.preferred_side_profile: Use the thickness shown in the selected design's side view.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Larry, 

I’m fine with the on/off buttons being placed where they are. I’m also fine with it being bulkier. 

I’ll work on a new logo this weekend. I don’t dislike the logo, just want to see if I can come up with something better.

value_updates.overall_size_constraint: A bulkier enclosure is acceptable to accommodate the internal solenoid and piping.
